system.description:
An implanted dispenser that delivers drugs on command, controlled by the bearer or remotely. It holds three doses (which may be three different drugs) and is used as a half action.

Poor: a shared reservoir that holds only one kind of drug. Good: holds up to five doses. Best: as Good, and it may also be activated as a reaction.
system.effectText: Holds three drug doses, used as a half action. Poor: one drug type. Good: five doses. Best: triggered as reaction.
